source: Creature.doAttackHitSimple order: calcHitMiss, then (if not missed) calcShldUse, calcCrit and (int) calcPhysDam
note: The four calls are made in the order doAttackHitSimple makes them, with one script per case, so the order of draws is pinned. result = { miss, shld, crit, damage (int, 0 when missed) }. Every case has 'script' (the unit values u in [0,1) that were consumed) and 'rnd' (every Rnd call in order: method, bound, returned value; get_int bound b returns floor(u*b), get_int_range o,b returns o+floor(u*(b-o+1)), nextBoolean is u>=0.5). Calls that draw nothing (get with bound <= 0, get(origin, bound) with origin >= bound) are not recorded. Replay the returned values in order and check method and bound.

geometry.note: The target stands at 'target'. The attacker has heading 0 and z = target z + z_diff, and stands at attacker_xy_by_relation[relation] (found by trying 32 spots 40 units away until the real isInFrontOf / isOnSideOf / isBehind agree).
